raw_response:
The figure presents three donut charts comparing the distribution of enterprises, employed persons, and net turnover across four economic sectors — Industry, Construction, Trade, and Other Services — in the EU for the year 2021, with data classified by NACE Rev. 2. Each chart is divided into four colored segments corresponding to the sectors, with absolute values and percentages labeled within each segment. The first chart, “Number of Enterprises,” shows 19.0 million enterprises (61%) in Other Services (dark blue), 5.9 million (19%) in Trade (red), 3.7 million (12%) in Construction (light blue), and 2.4 million (8%) in Industry (gold). The second chart, “Number of Persons Employed,” displays 80.2 million (51%) in Other Services (dark blue), 29.5 million (19%) in Trade (red), 13.4 million (9%) in Construction (light blue), and 33.0 million (21%) in Industry (gold). The third chart, “Turnover,” indicates 9.8 trillion EUR (31%) in Other Services (dark blue), 9.9 trillion EUR (31%) in Trade (red), 1.9 trillion EUR (6%) in Construction (light blue), and 10.6 trillion EUR (33%) in Industry (gold). A shared legend at the bottom identifies the color coding for each sector. All charts use consistent color assignments across categories, and no segments are visually emphasized through separation or explosion. The segments in each chart appear ordered clockwise starting from the top-right, though not strictly by size.
